predicate.label: succeeded person in role
predicate.definition: Person X took over a role previously held by person Y.
includes: explicit succession or replacement in an office or professional role
clearly established temporary or acting replacement
excludes: X appointed a third person to replace Y
generic opposition, criticism, or substitution unrelated to a role
a proposed successor without established tenure
ambiguous: bare replace where appointing versus taking over is unresolved
candidate or announced future replacement without tenure
predicate.notes: Direction is successor to predecessor. It does not imply that X and Y are the same person or held office simultaneously.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit succession or replacement in an office or professional role; historical successor taking office; clearly established temporary or acting replacement. Excludes: X appointed a third person to replace Y; generic opposition, criticism, or substitution unrelated to a role; a proposed successor without established tenure. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare replace where appointing versus taking over is unresolved; unclear predecessor or role; candidate or announced future replacement without tenure. Direction is successor to predecessor. It does not imply that X and Y are the same person or held office simultaneously.

rationale: Replace/succeed and predecessor-successor person arguments dominate; generic replace still needs taking-office rather than appointing-another interpretation.
